comparison.objective: Candidate finishes HELICOIL inserts; record loads a blank against stops and clamps it with an eccentric cam.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires coaxial mandrel holding, hammer impact, withdrawal, and fragment recovery; record requires registration against fixture stops and rotational cam closure.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four contact-loaded fractures, no displacement/damage, and all fragments contained; record requires the blank to remain registered and clamped after release, though the body provides no numeric tolerances.
comparison.reason: Fixture registration and sustained cam clamping differ from sacrificial tang fracture and debris collection.
